services.name: Art Classes
services.desc: The Fredericton Region Museum invites you to take part in small-group drawing and watercolour lessons, designed to inspire creativity in a welcoming and historic setting. Whether you are just beginning or looking to refine your skills, these workshops offer a unique opportunity to learn, create, and connect with the museum’s rich collection. With a maximum of five participants per group, each session ensures individual attention and a supportive atmosphere. Participants will: The program is open to all ages - youth, adults, and seniors alike. To make participation accessible: All sessions take place indoors at the Fredericton Region Museum, providing a comfortable and engaging environment
